privacyAck: Projection-only advisory. No coordinates, no proprietary catalog db3, and no fire, enqueue, or approve authority.

draftThresholds.note: Draft until calibrated. Below the floor the chrome lists alternative weapon families and still does not fire.

threat_urgency.instructions: Score how urgent this contact is for the player right now. Use only projection fields (range, DLZ, posture, fire-control track, hypersonic flag). Never imply engage, enqueue, or approve.
criteria: watch — keep on the recommendation row
immediate — top of the advisory sort

weapon_family_recommend.instructions: Choose the weapon family to show as the advisory recommendation for this contact. Closed set only. This choice never fires and never enqueues Accept.

wra_exhaustion_warn.instructions: Return yes when magazine, shotgun threshold, or WRA salvo/range says the recommendation should warn that the weapon load is exhausted or over the salvo limit. Warning only.

criteria.yes: Show the WRA exhaustion warning on the advisory row
